source: Source: T3, Swatch Group, Watchonista, Omega

slides.text: NASA tested three watches through 11 successive trials.
Only the Speedmaster earned NASA's flight qualification for manned missions.
Reportedly, Armstrong, Aldrin and Collins wore Speedmasters on Apollo 11.
On Apollo 13, the crew timed critical manual engine burns with a Speedmaster.
